title: Gift cards
summary: Customers can buy a gift card, spend it at checkout and see what is left on it.

prs.title: Redeem a gift card at checkout

6:H1.why: How a split payment should look to a customer is a shop-experience call, and only you can decide how much surprise at checkout is acceptable.
6:H1.context: A gift card that covers only part of an order is spent, and checkout then asks for a second payment without having said so first.

options.keep-it: Customers with a small gift card may reach the end of checkout and be asked for a payment they did not expect; some will leave.
options.fix-in-a-follow-up: The stack ships with the surprise second payment for now; a follow-up adds a notice before it, with a revisit date.
options.fix-before-merge: The stack goes back to show the remaining amount before the customer pays, and returns with a new sheet.

recommendation.reason: A surprise second payment loses the sale.
